title: ochna humblotii
intro: Ochna humblotii, commonly known as the "Devil's Claw", is a plant species in the family Ochnaceae. It is traditionally used in Madagascar to treat various health conditions, including pain, inflammation, and fever. The health benefits of Ochna humblotii include its anti-inflammatory, analgesic, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as reducing pain and inflammation, and lowering body temperature. The bioactive constituents of Ochna humblotii include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
